note: Quiet Alberta Parks campground on Calhoun Bay, the east side of Buck Lake, off Hwy 13: a treed teardrop loop and a small north loop, with a hand boat launch and fish-cleaning station. No firewood sold. Four sites (03, 05, 26, 34) are only 20-21 ft. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 7, 2026) and shop: 36 unserviced reservable sites C$28, season May 14 - Sep 21 unchanged, vault toilets, non-potable pumps; max 41 ft (32 sites 23 ft+); shop closed through May 19, 2027. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone discrepancy 586 vs 596 flagged.
flags: PHONE (stored 780-596-2644): the page's 'Information: 780-586-2644' and the tear sheet's 'Pigeon Lake Provincial Park Booth Phone: 780-586-2644'. The page also says 'Please contact the campground booth at (780) 596-2644 to confirm if a second unit can be on the site' - the only place 596 appears, probably a typo of 586. Recommend 780-586-2644 (the Pigeon Lake booth that runs Buck Lake/Calhoun Bay). No Facility Operator line.
SEASON: page 'Season: May 14 - Sep 21' matches the stored manual season. Shop: 'Closed through Wed May 19 2027' (2027 opening May 20).
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT. 'Reservations can be made 90 days in advance' matches the provincial:AB row.
FIT: four sites (03, 05, 26 at 21 ft; 34 at 20 ft) are under 23 ft; 32 of 36 fit. Not a criteria problem.
WEBSITE: both stored URLs answered 200 and are this campground.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; confirmed): on the tear sheet (50 m bar) and imagery the main teardrop loop's west sites (12-21) are ~90-110 m from open water across trees and a reed marsh; sites 7, 8, 34 and the north loop's site 6 are ~20-40 m from a narrow meandering inlet stream (a few metres wide) across trees and willow - not a lake shore. The shop tags no site 'Near Water'.
PIN (52.99255,-114.71795): inside the teardrop loop, ~25 m from the page's directions point 52.992353,-114.718013. No move.
